experiments.name: Baseline + FLOAT32 (accuracy reference)
experiments.validation: PASS - all 9 test cases passed (higher accuracy than FLOAT16)
experiments.notes: Accuracy reference - 7.4x slower than FLOAT16 baseline

experiments.name: Mish: softplus+tanh + FLOAT16
experiments.validation: FAIL - ownership exceeded threshold (5.08e-3 vs 5e-3 tolerance)
experiments.notes: Slightly slower than baseline (0.6%) and fails validation due to FP16 accuracy issues

experiments.name: Mish: softplus+tanh + FLOAT32
experiments.notes: 29% slower than FLOAT32 baseline (68.5ms vs 53.2ms) - softplus+tanh is less efficient

experiments.name: Mish: SiLU + FLOAT16
experiments.validation: FAIL - all outputs failed (max_diff up to 8.6, expected < 0.07)
experiments.notes: 20% faster than baseline BUT completely fails validation - SiLU is not Mish

experiments.name: Mish: SiLU + FLOAT32
experiments.validation: FAIL - all outputs failed (SiLU is not mathematically equivalent to Mish)
experiments.notes: 10% faster than FLOAT32 baseline (47.9ms vs 53.2ms) but fails validation

experiments.name: iOS 18 deployment target (original mish)
experiments.notes: 1.4% faster than baseline (7.09ms vs 7.19ms) - BEST VALIDATED OPTION

experiments.name: Combined: iOS18 + fused linear
experiments.notes: 0.6% SLOWER than baseline - optimizations don't compound well

experiments.name: Skip irrelevant passes (GELU, PReLU, LayerNorm)
experiments.notes: Remove 5 irrelevant fusion passes - 0.6% slower than baseline (within noise)

experiments.name: Aggressive const elimination (10MB threshold)
experiments.notes: Increase const_elimination threshold to 10MB - 1.0% faster than baseline (within noise)

experiments.name: Optimized fusion pass order
experiments.notes: Add extra early conv/batchnorm fusion pass - 0.1% slower than baseline (essentially identical)

experiments.name: Identity mask elimination (fixed 19x19 board)
experiments.validation: PASS - 8 of 9 test cases passed (partial_mask_9x9 fails as expected)
experiments.notes: 6.5% faster than baseline (6.72ms vs 7.19ms) - BEST OVERALL PERFORMANCE. Eliminates mask operations by precomputing mask-derived constants (mask_sum=361, sqrt_s14_m01=0.5, sq_s01=0.15). Only valid for full board inference (all mask values = 1.0). Incompatible with partial boards.

conclusions: Original Mish (6-op exp-based) performs well and passes all validation
softplus+tanh Mish fails validation with FLOAT16 due to Neural Engine precision issues (issue #2359)
softplus+tanh Mish is actually 29% SLOWER than original in FLOAT32 mode
SiLU provides 20% speedup but completely fails validation - it's a different activation function
iOS18 deployment target provides 1.4% speedup while maintaining accuracy
Fused linear provides 0.7% speedup while maintaining accuracy
Combining iOS18 + fused linear is actually slower than iOS18 alone
Phase 4 low-priority optimizations (skip irrelevant passes, aggressive const elimination, optimized fusion order) showed no meaningful performance impact (all within measurement noise)
Mask elimination (Experiment 10) provides the BEST performance improvement at 6.5% speedup (6.72ms vs 7.19ms baseline)
Mask elimination works by precomputing mask-derived constants and eliminating mask multiplications
Mask elimination is ONLY valid for full 19x19 board inference - incompatible with partial boards
The baseline implementation is already well-optimized for Neural Engine, but mask operations are a significant overhead that can be eliminated for fixed board sizes
summary.recommendation: For full 19x19 board inference: Use mask elimination (eliminate_identity_mask=True) for 6.5% speedup. For variable board sizes or partial boards: Use iOS18 deployment target with original mish implementation for 1.4% speedup.
